subject: [PATCH v3 05/14] NFSD: report listener creation failures through extack

2026-08-28.patch_summary: This patch improves the error reporting in the NFSD (Network File System Daemon) listener creation process by providing more detailed information to userland when a failure occurs. Specifically, it records and reports the attribute and transport name of the entry that failed, allowing for better diagnosis and troubleshooting. The patch modifies the nfsd_nl_listener_set_doit function to set an extack with the relevant error message and details after each loop iteration.
